prompt: Stage 4-2, level 8, 38 HP. You rolled 40 gold for a second copy of your 4-cost AD carry: you found one, so you hold a pair, plus a 2-star 4-cost tank. On the way you bought one copy of a 4-cost AP caster that a stats site rates above your carry. You have 18 gold, a loose tank component and a loose AP component. Commit or pivot?

lobby.note: 2-star of your carry with three items
One copy of your carry on the bench
2-star of the AP caster with two AP items

options.label: Commit: stop rolling, slam the tank component on the 2-star tank, keep the carry pair, sell the caster, position defensively, and roll for the third copy at 4-5 with 18 plus two rounds of income
Pivot: sell the carry pair for 8, keep the caster and the AP component, and roll 26 for two more caster copies
Roll the last 18 now: one copy finishes the 2-star and everything else is secondary

explanation:
A pivot after a failed rolldown is only a pivot if the rolldown found the new line for you. It found one copy of a caster whose 2-star Seat 4 already owns with two AP items: you would start a contested line from one copy, 26 gold and one component. That is damage control that ends 7th.

What the rolldown did find is worth keeping: the tank 2-star with a slammed item slows the bleeding, and the carry pair is one copy from the board you planned. Count the pool: 10 copies, you hold 2, Seat 3 holds 3, Seat 6 holds 1, so 4 remain and one shop shows one about 5% of the time. The last 18 gold is nine shops, roughly one chance in three, and a miss leaves you at 0 gold and 38 HP taking 13 a loss. At 4-5 you have about 30, fifteen shops, closer to a coin flip.

So: slam everything, 2-star what you found, and roll once more at 4-5 with a floor. Sell the caster: it was never a line.
principle: After a failed rolldown, pivot only to what the rolldown actually found; otherwise commit, stabilise and roll again with income.
commonMistake: Selling the carry pair for a single copy of a higher-rated unit and rolling 26 gold into a line another player already 2-starred.
hint: Count the copies of both 4-costs still in the pool, then ask what each choice leaves you with at 0 gold and 38 HP if it misses.
